paragraphs.source_en: In the flickering lamplight, Asai saw the venerable priest of Chion-in come and sit before the body, and she was suddenly startled. Was this all that a human life amounted to? For reasons she could not understand, tears streamed down her face amid that bewilderment. This inexplicable surge of emotion came because she had at last understood that Denzū-in had by no means been an unhappy woman.
